name: Tennessee Titans
status: Phase B job d3 (2026-09-24). Sort: redesigned (March 2026 uniforms and logo). Colours sourced (Titans 2026 media information Pantone specs via the repo palette); albedo = the palette Titans Blue (the daylight photo median (71,148,210) matches #4495D2). Numbers use all ten measured 2026 Titans college contours from official reveal/game photographs, with the existing red outline. The sleeve strings are horizontal bands (the real ones run at an angle: INFERRED). u1 font refinement (2026-10-05): modern base digit contours authored for torso and visible shoulders; helmet/name artwork unchanged.

sources.colours: data/nfl2k5_scorebug_sprite/team_colors_official_2026.json (TEN: Titans 2026 Media Information Pantone 279 C / 186 C / 289 C; NFL logo file)
sources.number_font: All ten 2026 collegiate numeral forms reconstructed from individually identified official Titans/Nike reveal jerseys and current club game photographs. Measured flat-photo proportions and corners are regularized to remove camera shear, cloth folds and lighting, so these are documented polygon approximations rather than exact proprietary font outlines. The narrow serifed1 (width/height0.3333), square stepped2, chamfered bowls, closed triangular4 and serifed7 replace retail donor contours. Original native heights, baselines, fills and red outline ratios are retained.

number_art.method: Ten per-digit source crops and measured traces retained in u1/fonts_followup/TEN. Coordinates regularized to parallel straight stems/counters; folded0 reconstructed from its visible octagonal perimeter and rectangular counter with consistent bowl proportions. Flat1/2/6, clear3, perspective4/5, partially occluded7 and sheared8/9 controls explicitly documented. No exact proprietary-font identity claimed.
